steps.title: Convergence analysis of the scheme
steps.instruction: Once, we obtain the ρi(0) values of the unknown parameters from the initial and bc's, we can find the values of ρi(t)’s at the subsequent time levels using the scheme given by the Eq. (11). Hence the approximate solution and its derivative at time t can be obtained by putting the values of ρi(t)’s in the Eq. (7).
